projection_id = 'en-019d95de-6d46-77c2-b409-5892f6081605'
probe_ids = ['ss-019d95de-6daf-75c3-8854-1521dbbaa5e4', 'ss-019d95de-6dbe-7583-8bda-970ff3b6deff', 'ss-019d95de-6dcb-7a02-b5e3-9e83963a1eae', 'ss-019d95de-6de2-7d70-b9f3-f613d77ffafa', 'ss-019d95de-6df2-7421-850b-b893bb3298e2', 'ss-019d95de-6e2e-76c3-af17-508881bb9dd0']

session_rows = []
all_done = True
for pid in probe_ids:
    s = temper.get('Sessions', pid)
    status = s.get('status', '')
    fields = s.get('fields', {})
    result = fields.get('result', '')
    session_rows.append({'session_id': pid, 'status': status, 'result': result})
    if status not in ['Completed', 'Failed', 'Cancelled'] and len(str(result)) < 10:
        all_done = False

all_obs = temper.list('Observations', "$filter=projection_id eq '" + projection_id + "'")
all_dirs = temper.list('Directions', "$filter=projection_id eq '" + projection_id + "'")

out = 'ALL_DONE=' + str(all_done) + '\nSESSIONS\n'
for row in session_rows:
    out += row['session_id'] + ' | ' + row['status'] + ' | ' + str(row['result'])[:120] + '\n'
out += '\nOBS_COUNT=' + str(len(all_obs)) + '\nDIR_COUNT=' + str(len(all_dirs)) + '\n\nOBSERVATIONS\n'
for obs in all_obs:
    oid = obs['entity_id']
    f = obs.get('fields', {})
    out += oid + ' || ' + f.get('probe_agent_id', '') + ' || ' + f.get('importance', '') + ' || ' + f.get('content', '').replace('\n', ' ')[:500] + '\n'
out += '\nDIRECTIONS\n'
for d in all_dirs:
    did = d['entity_id']
    f = d.get('fields', {})
    out += did + ' || ' + f.get('proposer_agent_id', '') + ' || ' + f.get('title', '') + ' || ' + f.get('reasoning', '').replace('\n', ' ')[:400] + ' || obs_ids=' + str(f.get('observation_ids', '')) + '\n'
print(out)
